name: nestbolt
description: Local fixed-sheet nesting for SVG, DXF and editable LightBurn projects, with independent checks and cutting allowances.
long_description: Import SVG/DXF parts or one LightBurn project, review import messages, and nest on fixed sheets with margins, spacing, defects, rotations and mirroring. Export original SVG/DXF curves or editable LightBurn projects per sheet. Lead-in paths are review guides; common-line cuts need CAM preparation and may increase material use. Every returned layout passes an independent geometry check. The same build, inputs, work budget and seed repeat unless the real-time limit is reached, which is reported. This bundle contains the Windows x64 server and needs no network listener or account. Choose an existing local workspace: Nestbolt reads and writes only inside it and never overwrites files.

tools.name: import_parts
tools.description: Import SVG/DXF parts or one editable LightBurn project, with geometry and import messages in millimetres.

tools.name: nest
tools.description: Nest library parts with a repeatable work budget, validate, and write per-sheet SVG/DXF or preserving LightBurn files.

tools.name: validate_layout
tools.description: Check a layout file against the parts, sheets and spacing with the independent validator.

tools.name: export_layout
tools.description: Export validated layouts from original curves as SVG/DXF or preserving LightBurn projects; lead review files are separate.

tools.name: estimate_sheets
tools.description: Give a fast lower bound on sheets from net part area; it is never a layout.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Existing local folder inside which Nestbolt reads drawings and writes libraries, layouts and exports. Nests go to nestbolt/runs unless you name another folder. Startup creates nothing. Workspace checks are not an OS sandbox.
